_comment: db.ascension.gg reports a wrong 'creates' count for the custom High Risk recipes.
Verified in game: Fused foods produce 1, while the database claims 10.
The same field claims 3 for Distilled flasks, which is unverified and assumed
to be wrong in the same way. Yield multiplies revenue directly, so the
conservative value (1) is used until confirmed in game.
Sanity check against known-good data: vanilla recipes (Major Healing Potion,
Flask of the Titans, Smoked Desert Dumplings) all report creates=[id,1,1],
so the field is read correctly and is simply wrong for this custom content.
To correct one: add "<item_id>": <count> under by_item. by_item wins over
by_family. Remove a family entry to fall back to whatever the database says.
